name: io.github.Pranavj17/mcp-server-graylog
description: Search Graylog logs by timestamps, filter by streams, trace requests across services, and run composite incident analysis to debug production issues.

tools.name: search_logs_absolute
tools.description: Search Graylog logs using absolute timestamps (from/to). Perfect for debugging errors with specific timestamps from monitoring tools.

tools.name: search_logs_relative
tools.description: Search Graylog logs using relative time range (e.g., last 15 minutes). Useful for recent log analysis.

tools.name: trace_request
tools.description: Trace a request across all services using a trace_id. Fetches logs from ALL streams, groups by service/pod, and shows the full request lifecycle.

tools.name: get_surrounding_logs
tools.description: Get logs surrounding a specific timestamp (+-N seconds) from a specific source or pod. Useful for understanding what happened right before and after an error.

tools.name: list_streams
tools.description: List all available Graylog streams (applications). Use this to discover stream IDs for filtering.

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Get Graylog system information and health status. Use this to verify connectivity.

tools.name: analyze_incident
tools.description: Composite incident analysis. ONE tool call fans out to the full trace hop chain, pod-scoped surrounding logs around the first error, and a trailing-hour error baseline for the anchor service. Saves 2-3 LLM rounds when investigating a specific trace.
